blockquote.p: Draft mapping - not yet reviewed. These links between model elements and glossary concepts are a first proposal. They were produced systematically and confirmed by an editor, but have not been ratified by the CareSets governance process, which is still being established.

They are published to be reviewed, not to be built on, and they are informative, never normative: they impose no conformance requirement and do not alter the logical models, which are published exactly as released.

Coverage is partial. An unmapped element does not mean no glossary concept applies, only that none has been proposed yet. Every relationship is recorded as equivalent without that equivalence having been verified one by one. Expect errors and please report them.

body.p: Each element below is mapped to a concept of the Belgian Common Glossary. The mapping is published as a ConceptMap, not written into the StructureDefinitions, so the models are unchanged from their release.
This page is generated from the same source as the ConceptMap; do not edit it by hand.
